original_benchmark.notes: Four subsets: gsm8k (400), math (1000), olympiadbench (1000), omnimath (1000). Original harness is direct vLLM generation with the critique prompt; the PRM path (run_eval_prm_rlhflow.py) and voting mode are not adapted.

harbor_adapter.notes: The adapter covers all 3,400 items and oracle verification passes all of them. Not yet published to the registry; all 3,400 tasks are planned for registration. Parity has not been run yet: parity_benchmark_size, parity_sampling_rate, parity_costs and the agent fields will be filled in after the parity plan is agreed with the Harbor team and the experiments are run.
